name: Bhutan
shortSummary: Bhutan is one of India's closest partners, bound by a 1949 friendship treaty (revised 2007), deep hydropower cooperation, and shared strategic concern over the tri-junction with China at Doklam.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India is Bhutan's principal partner and export market for hydroelectric power.
India is Bhutan's largest source of development aid and its largest trading partner.

majorChallenges.title: China border pressure
majorChallenges.description: Continued Chinese infrastructure activity near the Doklam tri-junction remains a shared strategic concern.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued coordination on the Doklam tri-junction
recentDevelopments.description: India and Bhutan maintained close coordination on border security near Doklam amid continued Chinese infrastructure activity in the area.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reaffirms Bhutan's position as India's closest and most reliable regional partner on shared strategic concerns.

historicalEvents.title: Treaty of Friendship
historicalEvents.description: India and Bhutan sign a treaty of peace and friendship, later revised in 2007 to grant Bhutan greater sovereignty in foreign policy while preserving close cooperation.

historicalEvents.title: Doklam Standoff
historicalEvents.description: Indian troops intervene to halt Chinese road construction in Doklam, territory disputed between Bhutan and China near the strategic Siliguri Corridor, leading to a tense 73-day standoff.
historicalEvents.impact: Reinforced India-Bhutan strategic coordination on border security near the tri-junction.

agreements.name: India-Bhutan Friendship Treaty (revised)
agreements.description: Updated treaty affirming close cooperation while expanding Bhutan's foreign-policy autonomy.

agreements.name: Hydropower cooperation agreements
agreements.description: Framework agreements underpinning Indian-financed hydropower projects including Tala, Chukha and Punatsangchhu.

defenceCooperation.name: Indian Military Training Team (IMTRAT)
defenceCooperation.description: Long-standing Indian Army training mission supporting the Royal Bhutan Army.
